artist.name: Fly By Midnight
artist.place_of_origin: New York City, United States (formed); Los Angeles-based later
artist.short_description: Fly By Midnight — an Afterglow curated emotional-pop discovery profile.
artist.biography: Fly By Midnight is an American pop duo featuring singer-songwriter Justin Bryte and producer and singer-songwriter Slavo. An official Live Nation artist profile describes the duo as Los Angeles-based and self-distributed, and notes their fourth album ‘Fictional Illustrations.’ The group’s own Bandcamp release page offers an especially useful primary record of that album’s track list: ‘In The Night,’ ‘What If I Wasn’t Done Loving You?,’ ‘Different Lives,’ and ‘Infinitely Falling’ are among its songs, with a March 2023 edition date. That page also identifies two bonus recordings on its deluxe edition, including ‘Different Lives’ featuring Rachel Grae. The collaboration gives Afterglow a direct bridge between its softer confessional-pop profiles and a more synth-driven duo. Earlier catalogue entries include ‘No Choice’ on ‘Silver Crane’ and ‘Automatic’ with Jake Miller, while the 2025 album ‘The Fastest Time Of Our Lives’ adds material such as ‘The Weather’ and ‘Better Late Than Sooner.’ Their 2026 official website continues to promote new releases and links to their music and social platforms. Fly By Midnight's inclusion in Afterglow rests on the contrast between melodic, polished pop production and relationship-centered song titles and presentation. Any deeper explanation of individual lyrical intent would need a song-specific interview; the general career profiles and album track lists by themselves do not establish what the writers intended.
